== Summary ==
Identified: [[Justin Miyashiro]] (grey zip hoodie, glasses, and a beard; same person as the standing grey-hoodie player in [[:File:2025 Oregon State Championship 7.jpg]] and the portrait on the JUSTIN M / joyjoy 2021 Advocate Award card held in [[:File:2025 Oregon State Championship 4.jpg]]), identified by [[Bill Bisco]] on 25 November 2026.

A player in a grey zip hoodie, glasses, and a beard at the 21 June 2025 Oregon State Championship in Luke's basement, Portland. He is the same person as the standing grey-hoodie player in [[:File:2025 Oregon State Championship 7.jpg]] and as the portrait on the JUSTIN M / joyjoy 2021 Advocate Award card held in [[:File:2025 Oregon State Championship 4.jpg]] (the standings champion Justin Miy).

The 2025 Oregon State Championship in a private basement in Portland (21 June 2025).

* '''Event:''' [[2025 State Championships]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2025-06-22
* '''Camera date:''' 2025-06-21
* '''Identification:''' [[Justin Miyashiro]] (grey zip hoodie, glasses, and a beard; same person as the standing grey-hoodie player in [[:File:2025 Oregon State Championship 7.jpg]] and the portrait on the JUSTIN M / joyjoy 2021 Advocate Award card held in [[:File:2025 Oregon State Championship 4.jpg]]), identified by [[Bill Bisco]] on 25 November 2026.
